snc.text: The Cabaretti, who in Old Capenna served as druids before festivals became constant parties, are rumored to have a renewable font of halo and an Angel returned in their hands, and Giada, a girl who can turn sewage into pure Halo, is the secret behind it.
Xander orders Anhelo to learn about the family's new Halo supply, and Lagrella uses her relationship with Lacey to infiltrate the Cabaretti and steal a sample of Halo.

The Adversary hoards Halo to monopolize it while the Cabaretti keep it flowing, until his agents strike the Cabaretti at the Crescendo, gravely wounding Jetmir, and Jinnie Fay takes him to an Obscura safehouse.
Officers report the Cabaretti neutralized and other families compromised, so Ob Nixilis orders the families' heads and a hunt for the Font.
